entries.title: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic
entries.definitive_edition: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic is documented as a Windows PC release, with the full 1.0 launch following Early Access on June 20, 2024. The native PC release is the only sourced public platform and therefore the highest-fidelity and most-complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam or another official PC storefront.

entries.remaster_caveats: The game left Early Access with version 1.0 in 2024; post-launch DLC exists, but no remaster or alternate platform edition was found.
